name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Mystery

Dare to discover the unknown. Double-Stacked Mystery gummies pack 1,000mg per gummy with a powerful Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend in a dual-layer mystery flavor experience. Ultra-strong THC edibles with bold, unpredictable taste that keeps you guessing. Unlock the mystery – shop now!
